title: Noel Tata seeks Tata Sons meeting video, minutes; questions legal opinions on Chandrasekaran reappointment
excerpt: Tata Trusts chairman Noel Tata has sought the video recording and minutes of the September 17 Tata Sons board meeting that reappointed N Chandrasekaran for another five years, executives said. He also questioned the process of obtaining legal opinions after the meeting and said he was not given adequate time to present his views.

title: Consumer companies score low on R&D spending amid innovation chorus
excerpt: Indian consumer firms are asserting their commitment to technology and innovation, yet their investment in research and development (R&D) remains unremarkably low. Analysis reveals that R&D spending barely rose to an average of 0.9% of sales, with prominent companies like ITC, Britannia, and Hindustan Unilever experiencing stagnant or even decreasing funding.
